Q56 second half, RIGHT upper arm. ALL FOUR entries are null: the brachial artery does not photograph as a dark clotted lumen in this cadaver's arm, and the three nerves were not found. The label volume and the montage (data/ct_sources/task_outputs/vhf_brachial_cryo_right.png) are kept so the run can be reviewed; convert therefore produces no geometry for this subject.

The ids that WOULD have been used exist and were checked: brachial_a_r (data/vascular/upper_limb_arterial.json), median_n / ulnar_n / radial_n (data/nerves/brachial_plexus.json, side-agnostic). None is invented.
subject: ct_vhf_brachial

entries.note: SEEDED as the right brachial artery and NOT shipped. Tracked over y 498..396 on 60 of 103 levels from a medial-bicipital-groove seed rule, but the human check on the montage rejects it: the mask is a 2 mm dark patch on the medial border of the arm's muscle mass at the muscle/fat interface, with no pale arterial wall and no round lumen (median diameter 2.1 mm, p10 1.8, p90 2.7, against 3.5-5 mm for a woman's brachial artery). Her upper-arm muscle photographs as dark as a thigh lumen, so the worked near-black-core rule finds nothing; the local-contrast rule written for this arm yields a median of 0-1 lumen candidates per level inside the deep bundle corridor and no chain longer than 27 levels. The only vessel that runs the length of this arm lies 45 mm anterior to the humerus OUTSIDE the deep fascia - a superficial vein, not the brachial artery - and is not shipped either, because naming it would be a guess.

SEEDED as the median nerve and NOT shipped: the fascicle-texture walk held ONE level (y 496), 12.5 mm lateral and 4.2 mm anterior of the tracked artery. The plausibility gate nulls it (0 mm of course, 1 verified level, against 30 mm and 20 levels). The crossing of the nerve from lateral to medial across the artery could not be measured at all.

SEEDED as the radial nerve in the spiral groove and NOT shipped: 18 kept levels over 60 mm (y 461..401), under the 20-level gate, and a median section of 7.5 mm against 3-6 mm for the nerve. Its direction is right - it sits 31.5 mm posterior to the tracked artery at every shared level, 27-37 mm posterior per 20 mm band on this volume - but the artery it is measured against is itself rejected.

SEEDED as the ulnar nerve and NOT shipped: the walk held ONE level (y 495), 6.1 mm LATERAL and 27.8 mm posterior of the tracked artery, 160 mm above the medial epicondyle. The gate nulls it (0 mm of course, 1 verified level). Whether it ends up posterior-medial in the cubital tunnel could not be measured.
